summary: The exact candidate is a partial diagnostic and documentation improvement, not a full fix for the original issue. It names the failing MTP module, reports the matched Linear target and quantization details, documents a valid regex ignore, and protects genuinely packed MTP layers from a speculative prefix-only dense fallback. However, dense BF16 MTP construction with a broad Linear W4A8 target and no ignore still raises before checkpoint tensors are inspected, so the reported NEXTN startup failure remains.

tests.what_was_measured: Actual ReplicatedLinear construction reproduced the generic NotImplementedError for no ignore and for plain mtp.* / model.mtp.* entries; valid re: ignores selected UnquantizedLinearMethod. Imported source was /job/repo/python/sglang/srt/layers/quantization/compressed_tensors/compressed_tensors.py. Raw output: /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-36615daca858/review-evidence/base-scheme.json and base-scheme.stderr.

The independent construction matrix showed that no-ignore dense MTP still raises. The candidate improves the error with layer, matched target, format, W4/A8 args, and ignore guidance. Plain glob-looking ignores still raise; the documented regex selects dense storage for both prefix forms.

At the exact candidate, 23 focused tests and 4 subtests passed. The NEXTN regression intentionally asserts that dense no-ignore construction raises, so this is hardening of the diagnostic/safety boundary rather than proof of original-issue resolution. Raw output: /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-36615daca858/review-evidence/candidate-focused-tests.txt.

On one AMD Instinct MI355X, an explicit re:mtp\..* ignore selected UnquantizedLinearMethod and BF16 GPU output had maximum absolute error 0.0152130126953125 versus an independent CPU FP32 matmul over BF16-rounded inputs and weights. This validates only the explicit-ignore dense path. Raw output: /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-36615daca858/review-evidence/gpu-dense-ignore.txt.

gpu_evidence: One AMD Instinct MI355X (gfx950), Torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2, HIP 7.2.26015; repository source import confirmed at /job/repo/python/sglang/srt/layers/quantization/compressed_tensors/compressed_tensors.py.
remaining_counterexamples: Dense mtp.layers.0.self_attn.qkv_proj.weight with broad Linear W4A8 targeting and no MTP ignore still raises NotImplementedError during ReplicatedLinear construction, before checkpoint tensor names can distinguish dense from packed storage.
The candidate requires users or checkpoint producers to add a valid re: ignore; it does not implement the original request to make a dense MTP module without such metadata start successfully.

Actual packed MTP checkpoint loading remains unverified. The candidate test only proves that construction does not silently select UnquantizedLinearMethod for the shared pre-load prefix/configuration case.
remaining_limitations: No Qwen3-Next checkpoint weights were available, so full NEXTN server startup and real dense/packed checkpoint tensor loading were not exercised.

The original environment was 2x H100 NVL with TP2/EP2. Review execution used one AMD Instinct MI355X (gfx950), so NVIDIA-specific, multi-GPU, tensor-parallel, and expert-parallel behavior remains unverified.
No native source changed in the candidate, and repository-environment.json provides no separate native build target; no native rebuild was applicable.
The deterministic tiny Llama serving fixture cannot qualify Qwen3-Next/MTP architecture or compressed-tensors checkpoint loading, so it was not used as substitute evidence.
